Specification: This specification models a single-variable transition system with one state variable x. The initial state sets x = 0, and the next-state relation makes x alternate between 0 and one of the values 1 or 2: from 0 it can move nondeterministically to 1 or 2, and from any nonzero state it returns to 0. The main temporal specification combines Init, the standard stuttering-closed step formula [][Next]_x, and weak fairness WF_x(Next). It also defines temporal properties about eventually always avoiding 1 or 2, eventual repeated return to zero, a tautological leads-to formula, and a postcondition that checks a specific TLC-generated counterexample trace structure using TLCSet, TLCGet, and ToTrace.
